name: disjoint-set union with path compression
mechanism: keep a forest of sets where each element points toward a representative; find follows pointers and flattens them on the way, union links one representative under the other by rank, so many merges and membership tests cost near-constant time each

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Tarjan's off-line lowest common ancestors algorithm' in section Combinatorial algorithms / Graph algorithms: computes lowest common ancestors for pairs of nodes in a tree

fails_when: no deletion or split of sets
the near-constant bound is amortised, not per-operation
instances: Tarjan's off-line lowest common ancestors algorithm
